contextToken.title: Context Token
contextToken.description: BOOKING_SESSION: opaque resume token for anonymous web flows; never put PHI in text fields.

correlationId.title: Correlation Id
correlationId.description: Optional tracing id aligned with Agent_Action_Log__c.Correlation_Id__c.

healthcareFacilityId.title: Healthcare Facility Id
healthcareFacilityId.description: Required for ROOM_RATES — reference rates for this HealthcareFacility.

lastClinicalEncounterId.title: Last Clinical Encounter Id
lastClinicalEncounterId.description: BOOKING_SESSION: optional link to last ClinicalEncounter.

lastServiceAppointmentId.title: Last Service Appointment Id
lastServiceAppointmentId.description: BOOKING_SESSION: link to last ServiceAppointment for context.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: INSURANCE = Patient_Insurance__c lines for patientAccountId. PREREQUISITES = Counselling_Prerequisite__c for serviceAppointmentId. ROOM_RATES = Facility_Room_Rate__c for healthcareFacilityId (optional roomTypeApi: General, ICU, Private, Semi_Private). SPECIALTIES = catalog text of active specialties. BOOKING_SESSION = upsert Booking_Session__c for returning-patient context. Uppercase.

patientAccountId.title: Patient Account Id
patientAccountId.description: Required for INSURANCE and BOOKING_SESSION; Person Account Id.

preferredFacilityId.title: Preferred Facility Id
preferredFacilityId.description: BOOKING_SESSION: default facility for rebook flows.

roomTypeApi.title: Room Type API
roomTypeApi.description: ROOM_RATES only: filter by Facility_Room_Rate__c.Room_Type__c API value.

serviceAppointmentId.title: Service Appointment Id
serviceAppointmentId.description: Required for PREREQUISITES — counselling checklist rows linked to this ServiceAppointment.
